documents.title: ServicePay FAQ | Common questions answered
documents.description: Answers to common ServicePay questions: registration, service availability, pending purchases, virtual accounts, Android app, account deletion and support.
documents.text: Skip to content ServicePay Frequently asked questions Straight answers about using ServicePay. Create account Sign in What is ServicePay? A Nigerian digital services app owned and operated by YUMPAY GLOBAL TECH. LTD, based in Kano. How do I create an account? Go to servicepay.ng/?mode=register and follow the steps. See the registration guide . Is every service available to everyone? Availability depends on your account status, service provider, the current catalogue, any required approval and your location. A feature appearing in the app does not mean it is open to every customer at every moment. My purchase is pending. Should I try again? If a transaction shows as pending or the result is unclear, do not blindly retry the same purchase. Wait for History to update, then contact support@servicepay.ng with the reference shown in History if it does not resolve. Will I get a virtual bank account instantly? Not necessarily. Creation of new virtual accounts with our current provider is temporarily unavailable, so we do not promise instant account numbers. Can I send money or withdraw to a bank? Wallet transfers and withdrawals are not currently offered to customers in the app. Can I book flights? No. ServicePay does not currently book flight tickets. Is there an iPhone app? No iOS app is currently announced. Use the web app at servicepay.ng or the Android app . How do I delete my account? Follow the steps on the delete account page. How do I contact support? Email support@servicepay.ng or call +234 913 615 1515 .

documents.title: Privacy Policy | ServicePay
documents.description: ServicePay Privacy Policy for YUMPAY GLOBAL TECH. LTD.
documents.text: Privacy Policy Last updated: 21 November 2026 YUMPAY GLOBAL TECH. LTD (“YUMPAY”, “we”, “us” or “our”) operates ServicePay, a digital services platform available in Nigeria. This Privacy Policy explains what information we collect, how we use it, when we share it, and the choices available to you when you use ServicePay, our website, mobile applications and related services. 1. Information we collect Depending on the ServicePay feature you use, we may collect information you provide directly, information generated when you use the service, and information received from service providers or other parties. We aim to collect information relevant to providing, securing and improving the requested service. Contact and account registration details such as your name, phone number, email address, password-related data, address, profile information and account preferences. Identity and KYC details such as NIN, BVN, identity documents, verification results and photographs where a feature or legal obligation requires them. Financial and transaction information such as wallet activity, payment references, bills, transfers, withdrawals, funding records, purchase details and transaction status. Device and security information such as device type, operating system, app version, browser information, IP address, log data, diagnostic events and security signals. Location information where required for delivery, interstate logistics, transport, dispatch, route support, fraud prevention or another relevant feature. We request or use location only as permitted by your device settings and applicable law. Feature data from Marketplace, Local Delivery, Interstate Logistics, Solar, financing, wallet, voice calling, Mini Apps, Transport and other ServicePay services you choose to use. 2. How we use information We use information to create and manage accounts, authenticate users, provide requested features, process payments and wallet actions, complete purchases and deliveries, calculate prices and fees, provide support and service notices, maintain accurate records, troubleshoot and improve the platform, and protect ServicePay and its users. 3. Legal, compliance, fraud prevention and security purposes We may use information to prevent fraud, abuse, unauthorized access, duplicate accounts and other security or financial risks; enforce applicable terms; investigate incidents; and meet legal, accounting, tax, audit, court, law-enforcement and other compliance obligations. 4. Financial, wallet, payment and withdrawal information When you fund a wallet, pay for a service, request a withdrawal or complete another transaction, ServicePay records the information needed to process and reconcile that activity. Payment processors, banks, mobile-money or telecom providers may process payment credentials or settlement details under their own terms. We do not ask you to send payment PINs or passwords through ordinary support messages. Keep those credentials private and use only official ServicePay flows. 5. Marketplace, delivery, logistics, solar and financing data If you use Marketplace, delivery or Interstate Logistics, we may process seller, buyer, pickup, drop-off, recipient, route, parcel, weight, vehicle, driver, rider, tracking, delivery confirmation and support information. If you use Solar or financing services, we may process application, eligibility, device, installation, repayment and related service records. The exact information depends on the service and the choices you make. 6. Sharing information We may share the minimum information reasonably necessary with: Payment processors, banks, wallet and withdrawal partners, and other financial service providers involved in a requested transaction. Identity and KYC providers that help verify identity or meet required checks. Telecom, messaging, utility, solar, technology and other service providers that help deliver a requested feature. Marketplace sellers, delivery and logistics partners, drivers, riders or recipients when needed to complete an order or shipment. Professional advisers, auditors, insurers, vendors and infrastructure providers working for or with ServicePay under appropriate obligations. Government authorities, courts, regulators or law-enforcement bodies where disclosure is required or permitted by law, or necessary to protect people, rights or property. We do not sell personal information as a standalone product. We may share aggregated or de-identified information where it does not reasonably identify an individual. 7. Data retention We retain information for as long as reasonably necessary to provide services, maintain accurate financial and operational records, resolve disputes, prevent fraud, enforce agreements and meet legal or compliance requirements. Retention periods vary by the type of information and service involved. When information is no longer needed, we take reasonable steps to delete it, anonymize it or securely dispose of it, subject to lawful exceptions. 8. Data security We use reasonable administrative, technical and organizational safeguards designed to protect information against unauthorized access, alteration, loss, misuse or disclosure. No online service can guarantee absolute security. You are responsible for protecting your device, account credentials and transaction PIN, and for contacting us promptly if you suspect unauthorized activity. 9. User rights and choices Subject to applicable law and reasonable verification, you may ask us to access, correct or update personal information; ask questions about its use; object to or limit certain processing; or request deletion where retention is not required. Some requests may affect our ability to provide a feature, and we may retain information where required for security, legal, financial or dispute-resolution purposes. 10. Account and data deletion requests You can ask YUMPAY GLOBAL TECH LTD to delete your ServicePay account and the associated personal data that is eligible for deletion. Use the ServicePay account deletion page , which is also linked from Profile in the ServicePay app. Ownership verification is mandatory. You confirm the request with a one-time code sent to the verified email registered on your account, or with your current account password. Requests that cannot be verified are not processed. Manual review. Every verified request is reviewed by ServicePay Head Office before it is approved or completed. What is deleted. On approval, ServicePay automatically erases eligible customer profile and authentication details and saved contacts, and signs the account out of all sessions. Before completing the request, Head Office reviews other connected ServicePay systems and records what was erased there, any deletion requests sent to payment processors or other partners, the records kept for legal reasons, the legal policy that applies and when retained records will be reviewed again. Deletion by partners is not automatic and is governed by their own obligations. Deletion is irreversible. You will lose access to the account, its profile and in-app history, and it cannot be restored. What is retained. Records we are legally required to keep, including financial, transaction, wallet, KYC, fraud-prevention, security and audit records, and records needed for disputes or legal claims, remain in financial and audit systems under existing access controls, rather than in your active customer profile, and only as long as required. Retention periods depend on the record type and applicable law. Payment processors and other partners keep their own records under their own obligations. Review. Unresolved balances, orders, deliveries, financing obligations, disputes or legal holds require review and may delay or prevent completion. Timing. We process deletion requests within 30 calendar days after ownership is verified. If an unresolved obligation or legal hold affects the request, ServicePay Support will explain it to you. You receive a reference ID and can check status on the deletion page. You can also contact support@servicepay.ng or admin@servicepay.ng from the email address associated with your account. Never send your password, transaction PIN, one-time codes or identity documents by email. 11. Children’s privacy ServicePay is not directed to children who are not permitted to use the relevant service under applicable law. We do not knowingly collect personal information from a child through a service where such collection is not permitted. If you believe a child has provided personal information improperly, please contact us so we can review the request. 12. Cookies and web technologies Our website or web applications may use cookies, local storage, session storage and similar technologies to keep the site working, remember settings, support authentication and understand basic usage. You can control cookies through your browser settings, although disabling necessary technologies may affect functionality. Our mobile applications may use device storage and platform services for equivalent purposes. 13. Third-party services ServicePay may link to or use third-party services, including payment, identity, telecom, messaging, mapping, hosting, analytics and app-platform services. Their processing is governed by their own privacy notices. Review those notices when you use the relevant service. 14. International data transfers Some service providers may process information outside Nigeria. Where that happens, we take reasonable steps required by applicable law and the relevant service arrangements to protect the information. 15. Changes to this policy We may update this Privacy Policy when our services, technology or legal obligations change. We will post the updated version at this URL and update the “Last updated” date. If a change is material, we may provide an additional notice through ServicePay or another appropriate channel. 16. Contact us Privacy questions, rights requests and data deletion requests can be sent to: YUMPAY GLOBAL TECH LTD , operator of ServicePay Email: support@servicepay.ng or admin@servicepay.ng Phone: +2349136151515 Website: https://servicepay.ng Country: Nigeria

documents.title: Delete Your ServicePay Account
documents.description: Delete your ServicePay account and associated eligible data, or make a personal data request. ServicePay is operated by YUMPAY GLOBAL TECH LTD.
documents.text: Account and data deletion Delete your ServicePay account Request permanent deletion of your ServicePay account and the associated personal data that is eligible for deletion. You must prove you own the account before we act on the request. ServicePay is operated by YUMPAY GLOBAL TECH LTD, Nigeria. Deletion cannot be undone You will lose access to your account, profile, saved details and service history in the app. You cannot sign in again with this account or recover it later. Withdraw any wallet balance and settle pending orders, deliveries, financing or disputes first. Never share your transaction PIN, BVN or NIN on this page. ServicePay staff will never ask for them. Request account deletion Three short steps. Your password or one-time code is used only to verify ownership and is not saved by this page. 1. Account 2. Verify 3. Confirm Registered phone number or email address Use the phone number or email registered on your ServicePay account. Email code We send a 6-digit code if a verified email is on the account. Account password Confirm with your current ServicePay password. Continue 6-digit code Codes expire. Check your inbox and spam folder. No code? It will only arrive if this account has a verified email. You can request a new code or verify with your password instead . Current ServicePay password Forgotten your password? Reset it in the app first, or use an email code . Continue Back Account: Reason for leaving (optional) I understand that deleting my ServicePay account is permanent and that I will lose access to the account and its associated eligible data. I understand that records ServicePay is legally required to keep, including financial, transaction, KYC, fraud-prevention and audit records, will be retained and not deleted. I understand that an unresolved balance, order, dispute, financing obligation or legal hold must be reviewed and may delay or prevent completion. Delete my account Back Deletion request received Your request now goes to Head Office for manual review. Keep your reference ID for Support. ServicePay processes verified requests within 30 calendar days. Support will explain any unresolved obligation or legal hold affecting your request. Request specific data instead Ask to access, correct, port or object to processing of specific personal data without deleting your account. Full name Registered phone number Registered email address Request type Choose one Access my data Correct my data Provide a copy of my data Object to specific processing Other privacy request Describe your request Submit data request What happens 1. Ownership verification Every request must be verified with an email code or your current password. Requests that cannot be verified are not processed. 2. Review Every verified request is reviewed manually by ServicePay Head Office. Unresolved wallet balances, orders, deliveries, financing, disputes or legal holds require review before deletion can complete. Support may contact you through your registered details. 3. Deletion On approval, ServicePay automatically erases eligible profile and sign-in details and saved contacts, and signs you out of all sessions. Financial records are preserved. 4. Connected systems and partners Before marking the request complete, Head Office reviews other connected ServicePay systems and documents what was erased there, any deletion requests sent to payment processors or other partners, the records kept for legal reasons, the legal policy that applies and when retained records will be reviewed again. Partner deletion is not automatic; partners act under their own obligations. Timing Processing deadline: 30 calendar days after your ownership is verified. If an unresolved obligation or legal hold affects your request, ServicePay Support will explain it to you. What we must keep Nigerian law and financial regulation require some records to be retained after account deletion. These are kept only as long as required and are not used for marketing. Transaction, wallet, payment and withdrawal records KYC and identity verification records Fraud-prevention, security and audit logs Records needed for disputes, legal claims or regulator requests Required records remain in financial and audit systems under existing access controls; they are not part of your active customer profile. Retention periods depend on the record type and applicable law. If an unresolved obligation or legal hold applies, Support will explain it. Payment processors, banks and other partners hold their own records under their own legal obligations and privacy notices. Need help? Contact ServicePay Support at support@servicepay.ng or admin@servicepay.ng , or call +2349136151515 . Read the Privacy Policy .

documents.title: Account and Wallet help | ServicePay
documents.description: Understand account access, wallet records and safe funding troubleshooting.
documents.text: Skip to content ServicePay Account and Wallet help Understand account access, wallet records and safe funding troubleshooting. Create account Sign in Check your own records Sign in to your own account to view the Wallet and Transaction History. Public search cannot read your balance or confirm that a deposit arrived. Funding not reflected Compare the funding status and reference shown in the app with your bank record. Do not blindly repeat an uncertain transfer. Use Help & Support to create a ticket for the support team. Never post your account number, balance or banking details in public search. Secure support AI Smart Support can guide you and, where enabled, investigate a record you select after authentication. A stored status is not necessarily fresh provider confirmation. AI cannot move money or promise a refund.

documents.title: Virtual Account troubleshooting | ServicePay
documents.description: Safe guidance for existing accounts, unavailable generation and uncertain requests.
documents.text: Skip to content ServicePay Virtual Account troubleshooting Safe guidance for existing accounts, unavailable generation and uncertain requests. Create account Sign in View an existing account Sign in and open Wallet to view any virtual account already linked to your profile. Do not use a public lookup tool or share account details with a search assistant. Generation temporarily unavailable This message does not establish that a previous generation attempt created no account. Do not repeatedly generate accounts. Use the existing support workflow so staff can check stored attempts and verified provider evidence. Avoid duplicates A previous FAILED or unknown attempt may require reconciliation before another request is safe. Only an authorized workflow with verified provider evidence may resolve that uncertainty. Public guides cannot confirm provider authorization or create an account.

documents.title: Transaction status and troubleshooting | ServicePay
documents.description: Understand successful, pending and failed transactions without risking duplicate purchases.
documents.text: Skip to content ServicePay Transaction status and troubleshooting Understand successful, pending and failed transactions without risking duplicate purchases. Create account Sign in SUCCESSFUL Review the transaction details in History. If service delivery is missing despite a successful record, report that record through authenticated support; a public assistant cannot independently confirm delivery. PENDING or processing The outcome is not yet definitive. Refresh History and avoid repeating the same uncertain purchase. A pending record must not be treated as proof of success, failure or refund. A separate new purchase still requires its own confirmation and authorization in the app. FAILED Read the transaction and wallet records in your own account. A failed label by itself does not prove that a refund is due or has arrived. Support can review the linked records. Never rely on public search to authorize a refund. Create a complaint After signing in, open Help & Support, create a ticket and select the relevant record where offered. Keep the complaint reference returned by the application. Do not send PINs, passwords or OTPs.

documents.title: Account security and recovery | ServicePay
documents.description: Protect your ServicePay account and use secure password or PIN recovery.
documents.text: Skip to content ServicePay Account security and recovery Protect your ServicePay account and use secure password or PIN recovery. Create account Sign in Protect your credentials Never share passwords, transaction PINs, OTPs, full BVN, NIN or card details in search, email or AI chat. ServicePay public help does not request them. Password recovery Use the app's existing password-recovery flow and the verified contact channel it offers. Customer identity verification remains mandatory. Authorized Head Office recovery requires explicit permissions and fresh administrator authentication, not a second-person approval. PIN recovery Only the customer should set a new transaction PIN through the secure recovery flow after the required stronger verification. Public help cannot reset a PIN, unlock compliance restrictions or approve recovery. Suspicious activity Contact support through the official app or support@servicepay.ng. Describe the issue without disclosing secret credentials. Do not follow instructions to transfer money to verify your identity.

documents.title: Complaints, tickets and human support | ServicePay
documents.description: Create a secure ServicePay complaint and keep its reference.
documents.text: Skip to content ServicePay Complaints, tickets and human support Create a secure ServicePay complaint and keep its reference. Create account Sign in Create and track a ticket Sign in, open Help & Support and use the existing complaint form. Choose the appropriate category and explain the issue without secrets. The application returns a ticket reference after successful creation. Track and reply to your own tickets in the app. AI and human assistance Open All Services, then AI Support for English or Hausa text assistance where enabled. For an unresolved issue use its human escalation option or the dashboard Help & support button. Account-specific investigation requires authentication and selecting your own record. Public page feedback A helpful or not-helpful vote on a public guide is only a local browsing preference, not a complaint or an acknowledgment from the support team. To notify support, create an authenticated ticket or send an email to support@servicepay.ng. Response expectations Do not assume a response time, refund or compensation that has not been confirmed through the authorized support process.

answers.en: PENDING means the outcome is not yet definitive. Check History and do not repeat the same uncertain purchase. Sign in and select your own record in support for investigation. This guide cannot confirm or change a transaction.
answers.ha: PENDING na nufin ba a tabbatar da sakamakon ba tukuna. Duba History, kada ka maimaita wannan sayen da sakamakonsa bai tabbata ba. Shiga asusunka ka zaɓi ma'amalarka a sashen taimako. Wannan jagora ba ya tabbatarwa ko canza ma'amala.

answers.en: Choose Data, select the network, recipient and available plan, then review the price before authorizing. If delivery is missing, check History and use authenticated support with the selected record. Do not repeat an uncertain purchase.
answers.ha: Zaɓi Data, ka duba network, lambar mai karɓa da shirin da yake samuwa, sannan ka tabbatar da farashi kafin izini. Idan data ba ta shiga ba, duba History ka nemi taimako daga cikin asusunka. Kada ka maimaita sayen da sakamakonsa bai tabbata ba.

answers.en: Choose Airtime and confirm the network, recipient number and amount before authorizing. Check the stored result in History. If the result or delivery is unclear, contact support rather than repeating the same request.
answers.ha: Zaɓi Airtime ka tabbatar da network, lambar mai karɓa da adadi kafin izini. Duba sakamakon a History. Idan akwai rashin tabbas, tuntuɓi taimako maimakon maimaita buƙatar.

answers.en: Use Electricity to select the available provider and enter the meter details. Review validation and the quoted price in the app. Keep the record in History and contact support if a token or delivery is missing.
answers.ha: Yi amfani da Electricity ka zaɓi kamfanin da yake samuwa ka saka bayanan mita. Duba bayanan tabbatarwa da farashin cikin app. Ajiye bayanin a History ka tuntuɓi taimako idan token ko sabis bai iso ba.

answers.en: Sign in and view Wallet for an existing linked account. If generation is unavailable or an earlier attempt is uncertain, do not repeatedly generate accounts. Support must check the previous attempt using verified provider evidence before a retry.
answers.ha: Shiga asusunka ka duba Wallet don asusun bankin da aka riga aka haɗa. Idan samar da asusu bai samu ba ko tsohuwar buƙata ba ta da tabbataccen sakamako, kada ka maimaita ta. Taimako zai duba shaidar kamfanin sabis kafin sake gwadawa.

answers.en: Your wallet and funding status are private. Sign in to view them. For a bank debit that has not reflected, compare your own records and create a secure complaint. Do not enter account numbers or balances in public search.
answers.ha: Wallet da matsayin kuɗinka sirri ne. Shiga asusunka don duba su. Idan banki ya cire kuɗi amma ba su bayyana ba, duba bayananka ka aika ƙorafi daga cikin asusunka. Kada ka saka lambar asusu ko adadin kuɗinka a binciken jama'a.

answers.en: Use Create account on servicepay.ng and follow the registration form. Provide your own information and complete the verification the application requires. Eligibility and service availability still apply.
answers.ha: Yi amfani da Create account a servicepay.ng ka bi fom ɗin rajista. Saka bayananka ka kammala tabbatarwar da app ya nema. Sharuɗɗan cancanta da samuwar sabis suna nan.

answers.en: Use the existing password-recovery flow and a verified contact channel. Do not share a password, PIN or OTP here. Only the customer should set new credentials in the secure recovery form.
answers.ha: Yi amfani da hanyar dawo da kalmar sirri da hanyar tuntuɓa da aka tabbatar. Kada ka tura kalmar sirri, PIN ko OTP a nan. Abokin ciniki ne kawai zai saita sabbin bayanan sirri a fom mai tsaro.

answers.en: Sign in and open the dashboard Help & support button to create a ticket and receive its actual reference. For AI text guidance open All Services → AI Support. For unresolved issues request human support. A local guide vote does not create a complaint.
answers.ha: Shiga asusunka ka buɗe Help & support don aika ƙorafi da samun lambar bibiyarsa. Don taimakon AI na rubutu, buɗe All Services → AI Support. Idan ba a warware matsala ba ka nemi ma'aikacin taimako. Zaɓen amfani na jagora ba ƙorafi ba ne.

answers.en: EduPay supports school-fee journeys for participating schools. Sign in and check whether the school and payment option are available. Confirm the student and actual payment details shown before authorizing.
answers.ha: EduPay yana taimaka wa biyan kuɗin makarantu masu shiga tsarin. Shiga asusunka ka duba ko makarantar da hanyar biya suna samuwa. Tabbatar da ɗalibi da bayanan biya kafin izini.

answers.en: Use Delivery to enter the real parcel and route details. Review the quoted fee in the app; prices and interstate routes depend on current configuration and availability. Check the order record for updates.
answers.ha: Yi amfani da Delivery ka saka ainihin bayanan kaya da hanya. Duba farashin da app ya nuna; farashi da hanyoyin jihohi sun dogara da saituna da samuwar sabis. Duba bayanin odarka don sabuntawa.

answers.en: Logistics availability depends on the supported route and dispatch arrangements. Use the actual quote and tracking information shown in your delivery flow. Do not assume that every interstate route is active.
answers.ha: Samuwar logistics ta dogara da hanyar da ake tallafawa da tsarin kai kaya. Yi amfani da farashi da bayanin bibiyar da app ya nuna. Kada ka ɗauka duk hanyoyin jihohi suna aiki.

answers.en: Use the secure in-app NIN Verification flow where available. Do not enter a NIN or BVN in public search or AI chat. Review the shown fee and requirements; a public guide cannot verify an identity.
answers.ha: Yi amfani da hanyar NIN Verification mai tsaro a cikin app idan tana samuwa. Kada ka saka NIN ko BVN a binciken jama'a ko tattaunawar AI. Duba kuɗi da sharuɗɗan da aka nuna; jagora ba zai tabbatar da shaida ba.

answers.en: Browse the Marketplace for available seller listings. Review the item, seller, delivery arrangements and actual checkout details. Listing availability is not a guarantee that an item or seller is available everywhere.
answers.ha: Duba Marketplace don kayan masu sayarwa da suke samuwa. Tabbatar da kaya, mai sayarwa, hanyar isarwa da bayanan biya. Bayyanar kaya ba tabbacin samuwarsu a ko'ina ba ne.

answers.en: ServicePay Solar provides an application journey for available solar products and possible financing. Approval and funding are not guaranteed. Review the actual offer and conditions in the app.
answers.ha: ServicePay Solar yana da hanyar neman kayan hasken rana da yiwuwar tallafin biya. Ba a tabbatar da amincewa ko samun kuɗi ba. Duba tayin gaske da sharuɗɗansa a cikin app.

answers.en: Browse available Empowerment programmes, check eligibility and follow the application process. An application or approval does not guarantee a grant or funding. Follow the programme's actual terms.
answers.ha: Duba shirye-shiryen Empowerment, cancanta da hanyar nema. Aika buƙata ko amincewa ba tabbacin samun tallafi ko kuɗi ba ne. Bi ainihin sharuɗɗan shirin.

answers.en: ServicePay Amana is a family-support application journey. Check the requirements, availability and any approval conditions in the app. Do not assume that submitting a request guarantees assistance.
answers.ha: ServicePay Amana hanya ce ta neman taimakon iyali. Duba buƙatu, samuwar shirin da sharuɗɗan amincewa a cikin app. Aika buƙata ba tabbacin samun taimako ba ne.

answers.en: Use the published account-deletion instructions or the in-app account-deletion flow. The approved processing period is 30 calendar days. Read the actual policy for request verification and information handling.
answers.ha: Bi umarnin goge asusu da aka wallafa ko hanyar da ke cikin app. Lokacin sarrafa buƙata da aka amince da shi kwanakin kalanda 30 ne. Karanta manufar don tabbatar da buƙata da kula da bayanai.
